summary: Full e2e verification of new Expression of Interest (EOI) feature on MiCells site. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases green — POST /api/interest (valid 201, consent=false 422, missing name/email 422, invalid email 422, language='zh' persists), GET /api/interest returns records without _id leak, /api/health email_provider_ready=true, /api/enquiries no regression. Frontend Playwright E2E: nav shows 'Register' link in EN and '登記' in ZH between Insights and Partners in correct DOM order; clicking scrolls to #register; eyebrow '07 · REGISTER INTEREST' + heading 'Register your expression of interest.'; 3 assurance cards present; household_count input toggles correctly on 'Whole family'; empty-name/email submit does not hit API; missing-consent submit shows toast 'Please tick the consent box to submit.' and does not hit API; full valid submission POSTs to /api/interest, success card renders with 'Thank you.' + info@micells.io, reset button returns to form; record retrievable via GET /api/interest matching name+email. ZH mode: eyebrow '07 · 意向登記', heading '登記您的 意向表達。', submit '提交意向登記', nav '登記'; ZH submission persists language='zh'. Partners eyebrow renders as '08 · PARTNERS'/'08 · 合作夥伴' (via font-mono-tab class in Investor.jsx, not the shared `.eyebrow` class — cosmetic difference, still visible). Contact eyebrow '09 · CONTACT'/'09 · 聯絡' via `.eyebrow` class. MiCells® ® mark intact throughout.

issues: Eyebrow '08 · PARTNERS' is rendered via font-mono-tab spans rather than the shared `.eyebrow` utility class used by every other section (Contact uses `.eyebrow`). Consider standardising for consistency and easier selector-based testing.

critical_code_review_comments: Register.jsx line 50: client-side guard checks !form.name.trim() but the input has `required` attribute — browser native validation will fire first and the JS toast (r.validationRequired) will rarely surface. Consider removing the HTML `required` OR the JS check for unified UX.

Register.jsx uses direct axios call to `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/interest`; error path only shows generic toast (r.toastFail). Consider surfacing 422 detail messages so testers see which field failed.
server.py: consider validating InterestCreate.language against LANGS = ['en','zh'] to prevent arbitrary strings up to 8 chars from being stored.
server.py duplicates enquiry vs interest email/html helpers (~90% overlap in table row templating). Extract into shared _build_email_shell(rows, title, message_or_notes) helper to reduce ~80 lines.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to lifespan (carried over from iteration 1).
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_EOI_* and TEST_ui_* records in MongoDB collection `interest_registrations` via pytest and UI submissions (both EN and ZH). No cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EOI feature fully working end-to-end. Backend tests split into two files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (enquiries + health, iteration 1) and /app/backend/tests/test_interest.py (EOI + zh + enquiry regression, iteration 2). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. All 16 tests pass. Frontend has no functional bugs; only cosmetic note is that Investor section's eyebrow uses font-mono-tab spans instead of the shared `.eyebrow` class.
